notes: LowestMintGame is the only application contract in the accepted source (src/LowestMintGame.sol). Its constructor is (address initialOwner, IPoolManager manager) and makes no external calls, so it deploys on an empty chain. initialOwner is $owner, the launch owner; ownership is never assigned to msg.sender (the factory) or tx.origin. manager is the canonical Uniswap v4 PoolManager on Ethereum (chain id 1), 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, published in Uniswap's v4 deployment table; it is stored as an immutable and the constructor rejects a zero manager. Behavior: mint() costs exactly 0.1 ETH, swaps exactly 0.08 ETH for IMD in the configured native ETH/IMD v4 pool (zeroForOne exact input, empty hook data) and delivers the IMD directly to the payer, checking the payer's balance rose by exactly the swap output. Each entry records the payer and the exact IMD received (mints(id)), plus per-payer aggregates (mintCountOf, totalTokensReceived). The remaining 0.02 ETH per entry accrues in rewardPool with no owner fee or treasury share. The entry with the fewest tokens received (ties to the earliest entry) is the leader; when the game mints out at MAX_MINTS = 100 entries the final mint finalizes and pays the whole pot to the leader (30,000 gas push; a failed push defers to pendingReward, claimable by the winner via claimRewards). If the game does not sell out within 30 days of the first entry, anyone may call finalize() and the current leader receives the accumulated pot. After launch the owner must call configurePool(PoolKey key, uint256 minimumOutput) once with the existing ETH/IMD pool key (currency0 = native ETH = address(0), currency1 = IMD token, exact fee, tickSpacing and hooks from the pool's Initialize event) and a positive raw-unit IMD output floor; those values were not supplied in the brief and are deliberately owner settings rather than guessed constructor constants. Configuration is replaceable only while minted == 0 and freezes at the first successful entry. The owner has no withdrawal, pause, reset, upgrade or winner override power; ownership is OpenZeppelin Ownable2Step. No token, pool, hook, reward distributor, ETH funding or initialization call is part of this launch; deployment sends zero ETH.
